category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AC-P)
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-17 (Remote Access), AC-19 (Access Control for Mobile Devices)
implementation_examples: Manage remote access through approved channels (VPN, zero-trust access) with strong authentication and least-privilege authorisation
Monitor remote-access sessions and capture logs
Apply the same controls to third-party remote access
assessment_objectives: Determine whether remote access is mediated through approved channels
Determine whether remote access is granted per least-privilege
Determine whether remote sessions are logged and reviewed
Determine whether third-party remote access is subject to the same controls
